Name: Shemaiah, Chief of Elizaphan
Summary: Chief of the sons of Elizaphan who brought up the ark, with his brethren two hundred.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:8; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Elizaphan who brought up the ark, with his brethren two hundred.
LifeLesson: The mention of Shemaiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
